subtitle: "Open Q&A · code clinic · project check-ins"

No new material this session — it exists entirely to get your final project over the line.

## Before class

- Bring your **project code and data**, in whatever state they're in
- Review your [checkpoint feedback](../final-project.qmd) from Sessions 8–12
- Write down your two most stuck-on problems (code errors, interpretation doubts, "is this the right test?" questions)

## In class

- Open code clinic — bring errors, we debug them live
- Interpretation workshopping — say your results out loud in plain language before you write them
- Presentation logistics for Session 14 (order, timing, what to have on screen)

## After class

- **Full project submission is due via Canvas before midnight Sunday** — R script, dataset, and written report ([details](../final-project.qmd))
- Presentations are in class at Session 14
